metadata.title: "Agentized Ticket Triage in 20 Minutes"
metadata.target_audience: Operations managers, support leads, DevOps teams
metadata.visual_style: Clean, neutral background, small AI-Whisperers logo, readable sans-serif typography

slides.title: 30% Faster Ticket Resolution
slides.content:
Here's how we built a triage agent in 20 minutes that cut handle time by 30%.

No magic. Just measurement.

slides.title: Support Queues Are Broken
slides.content:
• Everything looks urgent
• Agents waste time sorting, not solving
• Complex issues get buried in noise

slides.title: The 4-Lane Triage Model
slides.content:
1. Auto-Resolve → Password resets, FAQs
2. Low-Touch → Simple requests, 1-step fixes
3. Complex → Multi-step, requires judgment
4. Escalate → Critical, senior attention

slides.title: Setup in 20 Minutes
slides.content:
1. Export 500 historical tickets (CSV)
2. Train classifier on urgency + complexity
3. Connect to ticket system API
4. Test with 50 new tickets
5. Deploy to production triage lane

slides.title: Real Results, 6-Week Pilot
slides.content:
Before:
• 45 min average handle time
• 80% agent time on triage

After:
• 30 min average handle time (−30%)
• 50% agent time on triage
• Happier team, fewer burnouts

slides.title: 3 Things We Got Wrong
slides.content:
1. Tried to automate everything at once → Started with 1 lane instead
2. Skipped training → Agent misrouted 20% of tickets initially
3. No feedback loop → Added human review for edge cases
